name: Incoming Gumdrop
summary: Incoming Gumdrop is a seasonal Hallow's End quest found in Ironforge, given by the gnome artisan Talvash del Kissel. In order to obtain a festive treat for a sick child in Stormwind, adventurers must first perform a playful train impression for the delighted gnome.

sections.title: A Whimsical Toll
sections.body: During the autumn celebration of Hallow's End, trick-or-treaters scour the major Alliance strongholds gathering unique regional confections. In Ironforge's Mystic Ward, the gnome Talvash del Kissel holds the coveted Gnomeregan Gumdrop. While sympathetic to the plight of the young orphan who desires it, Talvash insists on upholding the holiday's spirit of mischief before parting with his sweet, demanding a convincing train impression from anyone seeking a handout.

sections.title: Holiday Charity
sections.body: The quest forms a piece of an overarching seasonal endeavor to bring cheer to Jesper, an ailing orphan resting in Stormwind City. Jesper longs for four distinct treats from across the Alliance territories: nougat from Stormwind, a mint from Ironforge, a marzipan piece from Darnassus, and a gumdrop from Gnomeregan. By mimicking a chugging locomotive to entertain Talvash, champions secure the gnome treat to complete the young boy's holiday wish.

faq.q: What do I need to do to complete Incoming Gumdrop?
faq.answer: You must perform a train impression for Talvash del Kissel by targeting him and using the train gesture. Once he hears the train noise, he will gladly hand over the Gnomeregan Gumdrop.

Talvash del Kissel is a gnome jeweler from Gnomeregan residing in the Mystic Ward within the dwarven mountain city of Ironforge. During Hallow's End, he acts as the Alliance distributor for Gnomeregan's signature gumdrops.

faq.q: What is the Gnomeregan Gumdrop used for?
faq.answer: The Gnomeregan Gumdrop is one of four distinct festival candies gathered to fulfill the Hallow's End request of Jesper, an orphan boy resting in the orphanage of Stormwind City.

faq.q: Where can Talvash del Kissel be found?
faq.answer: Talvash can be found in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does Talvash make you imitate a train?
faq.answer: Hallow's End is rooted in the tradition of trick-or-treating. Talvash playfully demands a harmless trick—a locomotive impression—before he is willing to surrender his festive treat.

aliases: can i do incoming gumdrop anytime
faq.answer: No, this quest is only available during the annual autumn festival of Hallow's End.

angles.text: For exiled gnomes in Tinker Town, offering a Gnomeregan Gumdrop during Hallow's End is a cheerful reminder of home and mechanical ingenuity amid their displacement.
The pursuit of the festival gumdrop sends Alliance heroes traversing the kingdoms to ensure an ailing child in Stormwind shares in the holiday season.
